name: Price drop alert
purpose: Says when something they looked at got cheaper.
trigger: the price of a product drops, by any amount

steps.name: It just got cheaper
steps.job: Shows the item, the old price and the new one.
steps.subject: Something you looked at just dropped in price

rules: Goes to people who viewed it or started a checkout with it in the last 60 days.
Skips anyone who already bought it.
why: It is news, not a promotion. The price change is the offer.
watch: A one-cent drop is enough to send. Set a minimum if prices move often.
